attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys), with a self-signed CA created on node1, per-node server certs, and a client cert for the `replicator` role. pg_hba.conf on node1 restricts `replication` connections to `hostssl ... cert clientcert=verify-full` for the three cluster IPs only (default password-based loopback replication entries removed, and a catch-all reject rule added). Verified TLS+cert-only enforcement (unauthenticated connection attempts rejected), confirmed both standbys stream from the primary with pg_stat_ssl showing client_dn=/CN=replicator, and confirmed data written on the primary replicates to both standbys. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol (replicas first, primary last), proving changed boot_id on each node and full post-restart recovery of replication and data.
